verdict.rationale: Buzz's agent framework lets in-product agents search full channel/repo history and surface findings ('post the threads, not vibes') and the VISION doc promises a 'personalized feed' surfacing what matters to the user, which maps to AI-generated insights from the platform's own data. But this is delivered only via general-purpose agents/workflows rather than a dedicated insights/suggestions feature, and there's no first-party demo or independent evidence of the personalized feed or agent-generated insights actually working end-to-end. Missing for 10: a documented dedicated insights/suggestions surface, concrete example outputs, and independent corroboration that the personalized feed or agent history-search actually produces useful proactive suggestions.
